exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean section)
cohort: 25,513 deliveries, including 1,107 breech deliveries, over four decades (1980s-2010s).
finding: Cesarean section rates for breech presentation have significantly increased over the past four decades, while gestational age at birth has decreased and APGAR scores have improved.
gest_age: Variable, mean gestational age reported for each decade
